name: Charles Rowe
bio: Charles (Charlie) Rowe of Mingusville served on the round-up committee of the Little Missouri River Stockgrowers' Association in September 1885 and fell off Pierre Wibaux's horse during a race in 1886. He married Miss Bentley, also of Beaver Creek, at Dickinson on May 2, 1886.
